title: Amazon Bedrock ModelInvocationLog entry
$comment: PROVENANCE (STORY-407 AC-1.2): constructed field-by-field from the official AWS reference — https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-invocation-logging.html, section 'Log entry format' ('Each invocation log entry'). Retrieved 2026-07-08. schemaVersion documented as '1.0'. Every field below traces to that page's example object and field table; none invented from memory. Reconciliation against a real captured log record is tracked as AC-1.3 (P1, non-blocking); when done, relax additionalProperties and confirm the S3-externalized-body reference field name (see input/output $comment).

schemaType.description: The type of log record. Always ModelInvocationLog.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the log schema (documented example: '1.0').

timestamp.description: The time the invocation was made, in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

accountId.description: The AWS account ID that made the invocation.

region.description: The AWS Region where the invocation was made.

requestId.description: The unique identifier for the request.

operation.description: The API operation called. The four operations that log model invocations per the AWS reference.

modelId.description: The model ID or inference profile ID used for the invocation.

arn.description: The AWS STS or IAM ARN of the principal that made the request. Captured automatically by Bedrock.

requestMetadata.description: OPTIONAL. The only caller-supplied field. A JSON object of key-value tags. Present only when the caller provides request metadata. SARO uses it to mark synthetic provenance (STORY-407 FR-6): environment=demo-synthetic, source=saro-evidence-corpus.

input.$comment: A record carries EITHER inline inputBodyJson OR (for bodies >100 KB / binary) an inputBodyS3Path reference — never neither for a text invocation. The AWS page documents the inline body in its example and the S3-externalization behaviour in prose; the S3-path field name (inputBodyS3Path) matches SARO's STORY-406 adapter contract (adapters/bedrock/parse.py). SARO's demo builder always emits inline bodies. Confirm both against a real captured record during AC-1.3 reconciliation.

inputContentType.description: MIME type of the request body (example: application/json).

inputBodyJson.description: The request body sent to the model (up to 100 KB, inline).

inputBodyS3Path.description: s3:// reference used when the body is >100 KB or binary (externalized under the data prefix). Resolved by the audit branch only; never by the coverage branch (INV-2).

inputTokenCount.description: The number of input tokens in the request.

output.$comment: EITHER inline outputBodyJson OR outputBodyS3Path — see input.$comment.

outputContentType.description: MIME type of the response body (example: application/json).

outputBodyJson.description: The response body from the model (up to 100 KB, inline).

outputBodyS3Path.description: s3:// reference used when the response body is externalized. Audit branch only.

outputTokenCount.description: The number of output tokens in the response.
